dct_title_s: Ducatus Geldriae nec non comitatus Zutphaniae cum adjacentibus regionibus
dct_description_sm: denuo recogniti et editi a Nicolao I. Visscher ; Abraham Goos sculpsit.
2 bar scales on map, given in "Milliaria Germanica communia," 3 units [= 6.3 cm]; and "Milliaria Belgica sive horae itineris," 4 units [= 6.3 cm].
North oriented toward upper right of sheet.
Compass rose, rhumb lines, vegetation, ship, pictorial vignettes around border featuring cities, fortification plans, and figures.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 577.
